claim.why_it_matters: The PDF prints this as a numbered section heading (bold, own line), like 6.4.2.2 on page 109 which the markdown renders as '###'; here it is left as a plain paragraph, so the section is invisible to heading-based navigation and section lookup.

verdict.reasoning: The heading text '6.5.2 Shared Data' is in the markdown verbatim, on its own line (page-110.md line 37), in the same position as on the printed page. On the 300 dpi render it is set in the same monospaced typewriter face as the body text and is not bold, so the claim that it is printed bold is wrong. Every other heading on this page is also a plain paragraph in the markdown: 6.4.4 Sharing Files, 6.5 INTRA-PROGRAM COMMUNICATION and 6.5.1 Transfer of Control. The only difference is markdown heading markup, which changes no content or meaning and is formatting only.
